title: Lynx — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Lynx.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Professional Outdoor." Premium tier. Lynx is the ultra-premium outdoor grill brand — part of Middleby Corporation. Their patented ProSear2 infrared burners and Trident multi-zone system deliver 23,000 BTU of concentrated heat. Smart technology includes MyChef app integration. Lynx competes at the top of the outdoor market with Hestan, Kalamazoo, and Fire Magic.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: High-end outdoor kitchen builds. Customers who want the best built-in grill money can buy.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Lynx:

• ProSear2 infrared burners for steakhouse-quality searing

• Trident multi-zone system lets you sear, grill, and smoke simultaneously

• Smart MyChef app integration for connected outdoor cooking

• Heavy-gauge stainless construction — built to last decades outdoors

• Part of Middleby family — same group that makes Viking and AGA
